items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: The interviewer states 'I knew he'd play them. He was Edward Quest as far.' The interviewee does not claim to have worked with, met, or known Edward Quest personally, but rather responds to the interviewer's identification of the musician previously discussed (Steve).

ctx.x: Anything come in his mind. Yeah, anything come in his mind, he'd say it. Yeah, he didn't care what he said, the way he said it, anything come in his mind, he'd say stuff I know he was playing there on the Island Charter. Man you couldn't get in the place. From the time he get there and the time he leave. He get there around. He do that eight. He get there around ten, eleven. Anytime. But the people still be there waiting for him when he come in. Man he walk back there and the people give him a big glass of…
Well, you could get in there like that. But, uh, I knew he'd play them. He was Edward Quest as far.
